_comment: Shadow collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed shadow-aura-snag` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_shadow.py.

readme.title: Shadow
readme.summary: Pokemon whose hearts have been closed, wreathed in a dark aura (after the shadow Pokemon of Colosseum and XD).
looks: each line wears one look: a violet-black body with a purple aura flickering off every edge (Misdreavus, Spiritomb, Unown); hyper mode, crimson-black with a raging red aura and red eyes (Houndour, Totodile, Druddigon); eclipse, near black rimmed with thin violet light (Zorua, Diancie, Rowlet); smoke, grey-black with dark wisps rising (Lickitung, Dunsparce, Eiscue); ember, charred with smouldering crimson cracks (Cyclizar, Hitmonlee, Yamper); cipher, dark violet broken by glitching scanlines (Spoink, Karrablast, Bramblin)
the aura burns and flickers in the dark
shiny: the aura's colour turned round the colour wheel
